items.label: 处境与可能的担心
items.prompt: Why might Nia be worried near the start?
items.answer: Her bridge is broken, and little lesson time remains.
items.reason: 桥从中间断开，而且只剩十分钟；合起来支持“可能担心来不及完成”，不能据此认定她每次上手工课都害怕。
items.hint: 把问题发生的时间和人物处境接起来；might保留推断的分寸。
items.material:
THE PAPER BRIDGE
Nia's paper bridge had split in the middle.
'The lesson ends in ten minutes,' the teacher said, and Nia looked at the clock.
Arun put his own model down and went over to Nia.
He asked her which joint had come loose.
Arun held one strip while Nia added a piece of tape.
When Nia reached for the next piece of tape, Arun took his hand away.
'Try this part yourself,' he said, staying beside her.
At the end, Nia carried the bridge, now joined with tape, to the display table.
Arun was still putting the final labels on his own model.

transfer.passage: Eva read her speech very quickly. Sam tapped the pause marks on her page. Eva tried again, leaving a short pause at each mark. 'Now I can follow your ideas,' Sam said.
transfer.stem: What does Sam's final comment suggest?

options.text: He finds Eva's ideas easier to follow after she adds pauses.
Eva has already won first prize in a speech competition.
Every listener will understand every speech Eva gives.

answer.display: Sam finds her ideas easier to follow after she adds pauses.

explanation.strategy: 把前后的做法和具体听者的评价接起来，推断范围不要超过原文。

steps.text: Eva从读得很快改为按标记停顿；Sam随后说Now I can follow your ideas。
steps.reason: 改变做法后的评价，支持Sam这次更容易跟上她的思路。

steps.text: 原文没说比赛或获奖，也没评价所有听者和以后每一次演讲。
steps.reason: 把这次、这个听者的感受扩大成所有情况，就超出了证据。
